adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `refreshAccessToken` now does `const res = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and then `const token = res?.data;`. But `refreshOAuthTokens` returns a native `fetch(...)` `Response` object when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` (see `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`), and `Response` has no `.data` property. In that sync mode, `token` becomes `undefined` and the subsequent `token.access_token` / `token.expiry_date` assignments will throw at runtime.
